mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_review WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_review WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_review WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.*, g.title AS goodsTitle FROM t_review r LEFT JOIN t_goods g ON g.id = r.goods_id WHERE 1=1
AND (r.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.from_user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND r.rating <= 3
AND r.rating = #{rating}
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
